response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior engineer (~14 years) with strong web/backend credentials, distributed systems exposure, and demonstrable low-latency work at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic. However, the role centers on modern C++/STL development for industrial automation platforms, and his C/C++ experience is limited to a 7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project — it does not appear in his listed skills. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL secure engineering, MQTT/industrial protocols, message-broker architectures in C++, UML/architecture documentation practice, or Azure. His degree is a BS in Computer Science rather than the B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech profile specified, and he has no industrial automation background. Strong engineer, wrong specialization for this posting.
strengths: 14+ years experience, including low-latency, event-driven, high-throughput microservices
Proven engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring, public workshops and talks
Open-source founder with distributed/Kubernetes platform delivery and full-stack breadth
concerns: Minimal recent C++/STL experience; C++ absent from stated skill set
No IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity exposure
No industrial automation, MQTT, OPC UA/Modbus, or Azure background
